hook.line: This one sentence is going to change how you use ChatGPT.
hook.visual: Tight selfie close-up of a woman in a denim jacket; blue label 'Best ChatGPT Prompt Hack' over her head, sentence captions below her chin.

beats.what: Claim: one sentence will level up your prompting; blue title label on top.
Green sub-label '(For EVERY scenario)' pops under the title, then both clear.
Setup: after describing your complex problem in the prompt...
The sentence itself: ask the model to ask you any questions it needs first.
Why: no need to write the perfect prompt, the model asks for what it needs.
What happens next: 10 to 15 questions, answer them, then let it solve.

why_it_works: 'One sentence' promises a tiny, copyable payoff, so the viewer waits for the exact line.
The tip is delivered as a quotable prompt the viewer can paste right away, driving saves and shares.
Large, close face (median 0.469 of frame height) and direct eye contact feel like a personal tip.
Short at 45 s, with the payoff explained in steps right after the reveal.
weaknesses: The key sentence is never shown as a standalone on-screen card to screenshot.
Almost no visual change after the title clears; one cut in 45 s.
Captions sit in the bottom band, mostly outside the safe area (0.981 share).
for_robert: When the payoff is one exact prompt, put it on screen as its own card; Fred could hold up the card like a sign so the line is screenshot-ready.
